summary: Iteration 11 (AI Product Packaging Preview — POST /api/assets/packaging) fully verified. 9/9 pytest tests pass. Flow: (1) temporarily toggled beta_premium_enabled=false via /api/admin/feature-flags with X-Admin-Key so the FREE 1/day cap actually applies; (2) registered a throwaway free user; (3) created a brand kit with auto_generate=false (no image gen); (4) validation cases — no-auth=401, empty images=400, unknown brand_kit_id=404 (none consumed a generation); (5) happy path: POST /api/assets/packaging with style='box' + one tiny base64 PNG returned 200 with asset.type='packaging', non-empty image_b64, no _id leak (CONSUMED EXACTLY 1 Gemini image gen — as constrained); (6) 2nd call on the same free account returned 402 with the daily-limit message (no extra gen); (7) the packaging asset appears in GET /api/assets and in GET /api/brand-kits/{id} asset listing; (8) DELETE /api/assets/{id} succeeded and follow-up GET returned 404; (9) premium bypass verified by code inspection of check_and_count_packaging (is_premium(user) → early return; FREE_DAILY_PACKAGING=1). Feature flags RESTORED at module teardown to {beta_premium_enabled:true, demo_account_visible:false, allow_new_signups:true} — confirmed via /api/config/flags and /api/admin/feature-flags after the run.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1099 POST /assets/packaging correctly orders checks: images empty (400) → brand kit ownership lookup (404) → check_and_count_packaging (402) → AI call → refund on failure. This guarantees validation errors do not consume generations.
server.py:339 check_and_count_packaging short-circuits for premium via is_premium(user); FREE_DAILY_PACKAGING=1 matches the spec.
server.py:353 refund_packaging correctly guards with $gt:0 so it cannot make the counter negative.
Packaging asset doc excludes _id on return (doc.pop('_id', None)) — no MongoDB ObjectId leak.

brand_kits/{id} GET returns assets list (including packaging) — but excludes image_b64 from that list to keep payload small (server.py:922). Detail endpoint /api/assets/{id} correctly returns the full image_b64 for the deletable-check flow.
ai_service.generate_image now accepts images=[b64] via ImageContent and forwards up to 2 references — matches the endpoint's body.images[:2] slicing (server.py:1121).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11.py (new pytest module for the packaging endpoint; also loads BASE_URL from /app/frontend/.env and ADMIN_API_KEY from /app/backend/.env at import time)
seed_data_creation: One throwaway free user TEST_pkg_<hex>@example.com and one brand kit named 'TEST_PkgKit' (auto_generate=false) were created. The packaging asset generated during the happy path was deleted by the test itself. Feature flags were toggled to beta_premium_enabled=false during the module and RESTORED to true at teardown; verified via /api/config/flags and /api/admin/feature-flags after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: POST /api/assets/packaging {brand_kit_id, style in [box|pouch|bottle|bag], images:[b64,...]} costs 1 Gemini image generation on success. FREE_DAILY_PACKAGING=1; premium (or beta_premium_enabled=true) bypasses the cap. To exercise the 1/day cap you MUST flip beta_premium_enabled=false first (PATCH /api/admin/feature-flags with X-Admin-Key from /app/backend/.env) — and restore it to true after (autouse module fixture in test_iteration11.py handles this). Only ONE actual image generation was consumed in this iteration.
